personality_one_liner: Energetic, premium, and bold football club quiz interface designed for fast scanning and high impact.

spacing.rule: Tight, mechanical spacing for lists/stats, but large tappable areas for quiz options.

do's: Use on bottom tabs to overlay stadium background
Use on sticky header over the hero background image
dont's: Don't use on quiz option cards to ensure clarity

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing high score, profile stats, and prominent entry points to game modes.

states.empty: No prior score state: 'Welcome to Cak Mad Quiz! Play your first match.'
states.error: Failed to load profile data - retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section with stadium background + gradient scrim. Top bar with player avatar and rank. Large card displaying 'Local High Score' in gold text. Below: Two prominent buttons for 'Classic Mode (10Q)' and 'Time Attack (60s)'.

screens.name: Category Selector
screens.purpose: Allows users to choose between 'Guess Player', 'Player History', 'Club Trivia', or 'All Categories'.
screens.layout: Grid of large square cards, each featuring an icon and category name. Card selection is highlighted with brandPrimary borderStrong. 'Start Match' sticky bottom CTA.

screens.name: Quiz Gameplay
screens.purpose: Active match screen showing the question, timer, and 4 selectable options.
screens.layout: Top sticky bar with match progress (e.g., Q3/10) and visual timer bar (diminishing width). Large image area (if 'Guess Player' mode). 4 large blocky answer cards (surfaceSecondary). Correct/wrong animation overlays using Lottie/Reanimated full-screen flashes.

screens.name: Result Summary
screens.purpose: Post-match gamified screen summarizing score, correct/wrong stats, and social sharing.
screens.layout: Trophy image centerpiece. Large bold typographic score display. Stat breakdown grid (Accuracy, Streak). 'Share to Social' and 'Play Again' large primary bottom actions.

screens.name: Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Global ranking of players requiring Google Login to participate.
screens.layout: Tabs for 'Global' and 'Friends'. Top 3 podium layout. Below: tight vertical list of players with ranks, avatars, and scores. Fixed bottom bar prompting 'Login with Google to submit score' if unauthenticated.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 7 Dark-First Utility guidelines. Utilize #0F1115 as the primary background.
Madura United's primary brand color is #C8102E (deep red), use it primarily for buttons, active states, and accents.
For typography, use 'Bebas Neue' for large athletic numeric displays (score, timer, level) and 'Manrope' for readable body and quiz options.
Implement a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to black) over the stadium_background image on the Home screen to ensure text readability.
In Quiz Gameplay, ensure touch targets for the 4 option cards are massive (flex fill the bottom area) and easy to tap while holding the phone.
When options are pressed, instantly highlight the card with a borderStrong before showing the correct/wrong animation overlay.
On the Result Summary, heavily emphasize the Gold accent (#D4AF37) for high scores or correct answers.
Bind the haptics block strictly to user interactions: selection on standard taps, success on correct answers, error on wrong answers.
